claim: Package managers and registries solve distribution and installation; Packsmith v0.2 consumes packaged Skills but does not become a registry.
adopted: Keep legacy build/install compatibility and registry interoperability.
boundary: Do not make registry or package management the reliability-gate core.

claim: Reference validators and generic linters cover structural conformance.
adopted: Use a small evidence-backed doctor rule set.
boundary: Do not compete on the largest generic lint catalog.

claim: General agent-evaluation frameworks provide provider and assertion abstractions.
adopted: Borrow bounded assertions and baseline comparison ideas.
boundary: Do not become a universal agent benchmark or generic LLM judge.
